text: {"final":{"summary":"Portfolio and balance slowness starting about 15:10 UTC is most likely a cache stampede. Redis-cache logs repeated bursts of 8000 hot keys expiring within one second from 15:10:14. The holdings cache hit ratio then fell from 0.768 to 0.35. portfolio-svc fell back to postgres for holdings lookups, and postgres lookup time rose from 17ms to about 50ms with the connection pool saturated at 35 waiting clients. No change near onset explains it: the only deploys were metrics label renames and a log level tweak. Why the TTLs expire in synchronized bursts (for example uniform TTLs, a bulk cache warm or an app-side TTL setting) is not established.
